sentences.text:
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Additional Government Advocate representing the State and Ms. Kanchan Chaudhary, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the first informant /
complainant.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: By means of this application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C., applicant Ravi, who is involved in Case Crime No. 83 of 2022, under Sections 450, 506, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, police station Mataundh, district Banda, seeks enlargement on bail during the pendency of trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: As per prosecution case, in brief, informant, who is mother of the victim, lodged the first information report on 22.05.2022 against the applicant and one unknown person with the allegation inter alia that on 01.05.2022 at about 12 o'clock, her minor daughter aged about 13 years alongwith her husband, who is mentally sick, a minor baby and her old mother were in the house.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: She had gone to her parental house to attend marriage.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text:
At that time, accused-applicant barged into Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156433958/
1 her house and after tightening the hand and stuffing scarf (safi) in the mouth of her daughter committed rape on her.

entities.text: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: Thereafter, the applicant has also taken her obscene photographs in a naked condition.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: The F.I.R. further alleges that on account of said incident, her daughter got scared and the applicant while leaving the said place threatened her daughter.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is argued by learned counsel for the applicant that in fact, no such incident took place as alleged by the prosecution.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: The applicant had constructed the house of the informant but he was not paid proper wages and there was dispute of Rs. 20,000/- between the applicant and the informant.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: When the applicant demanded his money, she, in order to settle her personal score, lodged the F.I.R. of this case.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is also submitted that as per the ossification test report, the victim is aged about 18 years and the F.I.R. has been lodged after a delay of 22 days.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: During investigation, alleged scarf has not been recovered and no obscene photograph has been recovered from the possession of the applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: The applicant does not have any criminal history to his credit.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: Lastly, it is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that there is no chance of the applicant fleeing away from the judicial process or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: The applicant is languishing in jail since 25.05.2022 and in case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and cooperate with the trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: Per contra, learned A.G.A. for the State as well as learned counsel for the informant vehemently opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant reiterating the prosecution case as mentioned in the F.I.R. and by contending that the victim in her statements under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. has also supported the prosecution case making allegation of rape against the applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: Having heard learned counsel for the parties and examined the matter in its entirety, I find substance in the submission of learned A.G.A. for the State that the victim has made allegation of rape against the applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: So far as submission of learned counsel for the applicant that he has been falsely implicated in the present case on account of dispute of an amount of Rs. 20,000/- as noted above, I find that no such material has been brought on record except the averment made in paragraph 6 of the affidavit filed in support of the bail application.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: So far as delay in lodging the F.I.R. is concerned, it is well settled that in the cases of sexual offences, delay in lodging the same is immaterial.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: As on date, I do not find any material on record to presume the false implication of the applicant and to disbelieve the statement of the victim.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: Hence, I do not find any good ground to release the applicant on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: Accordingly, the bail application is rejected.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text:
It is made clear that the observation contained in the instant order is confined to the issue of bail and shall not affect the merit of the trial.

proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C. is issued and the applicant fails to appear before the Court on the date fixed in such proclamation then the Trial Court shall initiate proceedings against him in accordance with law under Section 174-A of the Indian Penal Code.
(v) The applicant shall remain present in person before the Trial Court on the dates fixed for (i)
opening of the case, (ii) framing of charge and (iii) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.
If in the opinion of the Trial Court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause
,
then it shall be open for the Trial Court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against him in accordance with law.
In case, of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
